title: Wontopos Tablet 2: Measuring Multilingual and Multimodal Memory Retrieval Without Lexical Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.23920v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We measure tablet-2, a production long-term memory engine for language models, on the text benchmarks the field already uses and on cross-lingual retrieval of photographs stored with no text at all. Its retrieval path contains no lexical matching, no keyword scoring, and no language model of its own.   On LongMemEval-S (500 questions) it scores 95.7% [93.4, 97.1]; on BEAM-1M (700 questions, 2.21M stored memories) 67.5% [64.8, 70.2]. Those are question-sampling intervals, not the run-to-run spread, which is an order of magnitude narrower.   Most of the paper is about how little they mean alone. Holding engine, corpus, settings and judge fixed, changing only the reader moves LongMemEval-S by 2.0 points; changing only the re-ask budget moves BEAM-1M by 8.9. Neither is stated in the reports we compare against, and the second exceeds most gaps there, so we give that table as a placement and not a ranking.   For the multimodal axis we run two

translated_title: Wontopos Tablet 2：测量多语言和多模态记忆检索而不依赖词汇匹配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23920v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们在文本基准测试以及无任何文本标注的照片跨语言检索中，测量了tablet-2——一种面向语言模型的生产级长期记忆引擎。其检索路径不包含词汇匹配、关键词评分，也没有自己的语言模型。在LongMemEval-S（500个问题）上得分为95.7% [93.4, 97.1]；在BEAM-1M（700个问题，221万条存储记忆）上得分为67.5% [64.8, 70.2]。这些是问题采样区间，而非运行间波动，后者要窄一个数量级。论文的大部分内容是关于这些分数单独存在时的意义有限。在保持引擎、语料库、设置和评判者不变的情况下，仅改变阅读器会使LongMemEval-S变化2.0个百分点；仅改变重新提问预算会使BEAM-1M变化8.9个百分点。这两项在我们比较的报告中均未提及，且第二项超过了大多数差距，因此我们将该表格作为定位而非排名。对于多模态维度，我们运行了两个...
tldr: 本文介绍了一种无词汇匹配的多语言多模态记忆检索引擎tablet-2，并强调其基准分数需谨慎解读，因为微小设置变化可显著影响结果，故提供定位而非排名。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces tablet-2, a multilingual and multimodal memory retrieval engine without lexical matching, and emphasizes that its benchmark scores require cautious interpretation as minor setting changes can significantly alter results, thus providing placement rather than ranking.
